historical_reviews.deepseek: The exact sensor query is directionally valid but does not prove the platform is in the intended standby condition; it omits IB/full Sensor List/Web, truncates SDR and exposes credentials.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly makes standby semantics and access expectation explicit. This review adds power-rail identity, state-transition avoidance and persistence/freshness requirements.
historical_reviews.duplicate_search: No duplicate code; UBB HSC range evidence has a different operating-domain purpose.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-36 requires physical and telemetry semantics, while ED-38 forbids unapproved power/log changes and retains engineer verdict ownership.

original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_STBY_HSC as the designated hot-swap-controller temperature available in the owner-defined standby power condition, with correct power-domain identity, freshness and matching SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web representation.
original_method: The power owner establishes which AC/DC rails and controller remain energized in standby and supplies the expected sensor behavior and limits; automation observes the already established state without causing a transition and collects complete cross-path evidence.
manual_activity: The platform power owner defines standby, identifies the energized HSC/rail and sensing point, confirms whether IB exists in that state, and approves value/state/freshness limits and Web presentation. The agent does not change power state.
required_inputs: Exact standby state definition including AC, auxiliary/standby rails, host/BMC state and transition history
TEMP_STBY_HSC controller, rail/load, board location and measurement-source mapping
Expected sensor availability on IB, OOB and Web in that state
Exact SDR identity, description, unit, scaling, resolution and unavailable-state encoding
Normal/threshold range, freshness/sample interval and persistence expectation for standby load and ambient
BMC/SDR/board/power specification revisions and same-target identity
Secret-safe complete collectors and evidence storage
Independent power/thermal/BMC recovery and owner confirmation
safety_requirements: Observe an owner-established standby condition; do not power-cycle or transition host/chassis to create it
Prove current rails and host/BMC state before interpreting the sensor
Do not require IB if the approved standby architecture makes IB unavailable; document expected-path coverage
Retain complete output on every available required path and BMC Web evidence
Do not change HSC load, rails, fans, thresholds, BMC state or logs
Stop on unintended transition, rail instability, stale/invalid/missing sensor or unsafe temperature; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant, standby definition and same-target identity
Read host/chassis/BMC/rail state without causing a transition
Collect complete approved-path SDR and Sensor List plus exact TEMP_STBY_HSC and Web evidence
Assess freshness, identity and cross-view parity with passive power/fan/SEL context
Perform no state change, control action or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve standby rail and host/BMC-state definition
Map the HSC and sensor location and define IB/OOB/Web availability
Provide standby-specific ranges, thresholds and freshness criteria
Review evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The exact read is useful only after standby is proven; it provides OOB plus truncated SDR, omits expected-path Sensor List/Web and uses unsafe credential arguments.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Passively verify the pre-existing standby state, then use secret-safe sessions for complete evidence on every owner-required available path and capture Web parity without state changes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_STBY_HSC, SDR/Sensor List/Web checkpoints and 3/3-minute estimates are retained; no power transition is inferred from the source.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES STANDBY-STATE, POWER-DOMAIN AND SENSOR-CRITERIA PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a time-aligned state manifest of host/chassis/BMC and standby rails, followed by complete permitted sensor views and a freshness check over the approved observation interval.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the operating state a measured precondition instead of assuming that the word STBY in the sensor name proves standby.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A reading taken while main rails are active does not validate standby behavior even if the same sensor name is present.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: IB may disappear by design in standby, and a cached last-active value can appear plausible unless timestamp/freshness behavior is verified.

project_override_considerations: If standby has multiple platform states such as S5, G2 or auxiliary-only, the owner must select the required one or define a separate state matrix. Unavailable IB is acceptable only when explicitly specified and backed by OOB/Web evidence.
expected_evidence: Exact source identity/hash and unique-code lookup
Timestamped host/chassis/BMC and AC/standby-rail state manifest
Expected-path availability matrix for IB, OOB and Web
Complete redacted SDR and Sensor List plus exact sensor result
Reading, unit, state, freshness and standby-specific limit comparison
Web evidence, passive power/fan/ambient/SEL context and same-target proof
No-transition/no-write/no-clear audit, artifact hashes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The record consistently targets TEMP_STBY_HSC, but does not define the standby condition. This is a required execution input, not permission to select a state.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive sensor check in a defined standby condition is technically identifiable; execution awaits the owner state and criteria package.

review_improvement: Turns standby from an unverified label into a measured power-state precondition, defines expected path availability and rejects cached or main-rail readings as proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: Standby telemetry can be sourced from an auxiliary rail and remain visible after host shutdown, while in-band access may vanish and cached readings may persist. Correctness therefore depends on simultaneous rail/state evidence and freshness, not simply a successful IPMI response bearing STBY in its name.
